inlines.v: WORKMANSHIP, noun 1. Manufacture; something made, particularly by manual labor. Exodus 31:3. 2. That which is effected, made or produced. Ephesians 2:10. 3. The skill of a workman; or the execution or manner of making any thing. The workmanship of this cloth is admirable. 4. The art of working.
